subject: Quanterra service impact — proposed stipend & trial top-up
messages:
From: Sam Wu <sam.wu@quanterra.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena.morales@quanterra.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0000
Subject: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — request for compensation

Hi Lukas,

We experienced sustained latency spikes this morning between 08:30–09:45 UTC that impacted our nightly scoring pipeline and delayed several downstream jobs. Error rate on calls to model-rank:open-2 rose to ~18% for about an hour and we had to fall back to our cached predictions. This caused a missed SLA with one of our hospital partners.

We need a clear remediation path and would like to request goodwill credits and an extension of our trial window while we verify continuity. Can you confirm the root cause and let me know what credit you can offer?

Attached: placeholder for any logs we can provide later.

Thanks,
Sam
Director of ML Ops
Quanterra Health
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@quanterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — request for compensation

Sam — thanks for the ping and I’m sorry for the disruption. We’ve already pulled traces and a preliminary view points to an autoscaling edge-case where a scheduled maintenance window in one AZ coincided with a burst of long-sequence requests. That caused backlog-induced queuing and degraded tail latency. We’ll send a postmortem within 24 hours.

Immediate proposal (to get you back on a predictable footing):
- Stipend: 50,000 token credits applied to your account (can be redeemed over 90 days)
- Trial/top-up: 30-day extension of current trial or entitlement we can apply to new environments
- Support: 4 hours of dedicated SRE/CS time to help validate failover & retention settings

If that sounds acceptable, Ben (cc’d) will coordinate the formal terms and Monica will draft the postmortem and the usage export you asked for. Can you confirm the account GUID and whether you prefer a one-off credit or a per-month token allowance?

— Lukas
Senior Sales Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Sam Wu <sam.wu@quanterra.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 11:08:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — request for compensation

Looping in for approval flow and commercial treatment. Thanks for the quick triage, Lukas. A couple of notes:
- Standard policy: credits > $5k equivalent need manager approval (Markus, can you confirm?)
- We should propose the stipend as a one-time credit (50k tokens) plus a 30-day trial-topup, documented in an amendment.
- If Quanterra wants a recurring monthly allowance instead, we’ll need to convert to a promotional package (sales-approved).

Ben
Account Executive — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 12:42:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — request for compensation

Approved in principle for the one-time stipend and the 30-day trial-topup. Please document:
- 50,000 token credit, redeemable within 90 days
- 30-day extension applied to the existing trial entitlement
- 4 hours SRE/CS time to be scheduled within 14 days

Condition: if usage over the next 30 days is <10% of the typical baseline (post-incident), we reserve the right to scale back the credit to 15,000 tokens instead. Monica, please include that in the terms and ensure the postmortem links are attached. Ben, route for commercial sign-off and create the HubSpot amendment record.

— Markus
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@quanterra.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — proposed terms & postmortem draft

Hi Sam — attaching the incident postmortem (draft) and the usage export for 2027-08-01 through 08-05. Key items:
- Root cause: transient queue amplification during AZ maintenance + long-sequence burst
- Mitigation: fixed autoscaler guard rails + additional warm-up tokens on the workload path
- Recommendation: enable KV-prefix caching for heavy-scoring routes; Monica/CS can help apply config changes

Attachments (stubs):
- quanterra_incident_postmortem_v1.pdf (postmortem draft)
- quanterra_usage_20270801-0805.csv (usage snapshot)
- redwood_stipend_term_sheet.pdf (term sheet with conditional rollback clause)

Please confirm you accept these terms and whether you want a DocuSign amendment or a short email acceptance. Once we have your confirmation, Ben will generate the HubSpot amendment and I’ll schedule the SRE slot.

Thanks,
Monica
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Wu <sam.wu@quanterra.com>, Elena Morales <elena.morales@quanterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 17:21:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Severe latency spikes this morning (prod) — confirmed stipend & next steps

Sam/Elena — thanks again for the quick back-and-forth. Confirming the agreed path:
- One-time 50,000 token credit applied to Quanterra account QTR-2027-0421 (redeemable within 90 days)
- 30-day trial/top-up extension applied to existing entitlements
- 4 hours of SRE/CS assistance to validate failover and caching configuration (to be scheduled)
- Conditional rollback clause: if your consumption is <10% of historical baseline in the next 30 days we’ll adjust to 15,000 tokens per the term sheet (attached).

Ben has created the HubSpot amendment: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/QTR-2027-0421
DocuSign for the amendment: https://www.docusign.net/contract/ABC123456789

Sam — please reply with a short acceptance (or sign the DocuSign) and we’ll push credits and schedule the SRE call.

— Lukas

Redwood Inference
